embed.title: !role
embed.description: Give yourself (or remove) the server roles your admins have made self-service. Works in a DM with the bot.

fields.name: See the roles
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}role` or `{{prefix}}role list` — every role you can pick, with ☑️ next to the ones you have
`{{prefix}}role membership` — only the roles you have

fields.name: Add or remove
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}role add raids` — use the role name exactly as `{{prefix}}role list` shows it
`{{prefix}}role add raids pvp` — several at once
`{{prefix}}role remove raids`

Some roles belong to a group where you can only hold one (a team, say). Adding one of those removes the others in its group.

fields.name: {{#if userIsAdmin}}Admin{{/if}}
fields.value: {{#if userIsAdmin}}Add `user:<id>` to list or change another user's roles. The roles on offer come from `[[discord.role_subscriptions]]` in the config.{{/if}}
